values.note: 2026 non-fair camping $40 a night including up to 50-amp service, water and sewer. Dump station $15 a dump and water fill-ups $15 for non-campers' use as listed; golf carts $25 a day. Special rates for RV clubs of 50 or more. Read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: https://www.darkecountyfair.com/about ('2026 Non-Fair Camping Rates $40.00 per night. This includes up to 50 amp service and water and sewer.'; 'Dump Stations: $15.00 per dump'; 'Water Fill-Ups: $15 per fill up'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://www.darkecountyfair.com/about ('Approximately 600 RV / Camper Hook-ups available; 200 sites with water, electric (20, 30, or 50 amp) and sewer services. The remaining sites offer water and electric only.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: About 600 hookups: 200 with water, 20/30/50-amp electric and sewer, the rest water and electric. Largely wooded 185-acre fairgrounds.

sites.source: https://www.darkecountyfair.com/about ('The Fairgrounds is a 185-acre facility that is largely wooded'; 'Approximately 600 RV / Camper Hook-ups available'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Restrooms and showers; two dump stations.

facilities.source: https://www.darkecountyfair.com/about ('with restroom and shower facilities available'; 'There are two dump stations on grounds.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: No camping in August (the Annual Fair); some dates restricted by scheduled events and festivals.

season.source: https://www.darkecountyfair.com/about ('2026 Camping Schedule: Wednesday, April 15, 2026 to Thursday, October 15, 2026'; '2027 Camping Schedule: Thursday, April 15, 2027 to Friday, Ocotober 15, 2027.'; 'No Camping is available during the month of August due to the Annual Fair.'; 'Some restrictions may apply based on Fairgrounds Scheduled Activities and Festivals.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Self-registration on arrival, first come first served; no reservations. Groups of 10 or more should call (937) 548-5044 first to make sure no event closes camping.

booking.source: https://www.darkecountyfair.com/about ('The facility has a self registration system in place. note: Darke County Agricultural Society fairgrounds in Greenville, home of the Great Darke County Fair. Campfires allowed in a fire ring for non-fair campers, drought permitting. --Claude
